title: Bulk import books from CSV
body:
Support bulk catalogue updates:

1. New `src/csv.js` exporting `parseCsv(text)` → array of rows (arrays of strings), RFC 4180: quoted fields, `""` escapes, commas and newlines inside quotes, CRLF or LF line endings, optional trailing newline (no empty trailing row).
2. `POST /books/import` — the request body is the raw CSV **string** (the handler receives it as `req.body`). Header row must contain `id,title,author,price,stock,tags` (any order; extra columns ignored) → otherwise `400 { error }`.
   - `price` is dollars (e.g. `39.99`) → store `priceCents` (rounded); `tags` are `;`-separated (empty → `[]`); `stock` must be a non-negative integer; `id` and `title` are required; price must be a number ≥ 0.
   - Existing ids are updated (title, author, price, tags, and stock set to the given value); new ids are created.
   - Invalid rows are skipped and reported. Response `200 { created, updated, errors: [{ line, message }] }` where `line` is the 1-based line of the CSV text where that record **starts** (quoted fields can span lines).
3. Add tests.
plan:
Add RFC4180 CSV parser and POST /books/import route to bulk-import books from a CSV string, with validation, upsert behavior, error reporting including record start lines, and tests.
1. Create src/csv.js implementing RFC4180 parser and exposing start-line metadata
2. Add POST /books/import route to src/server.js to validate and apply CSV import using parseCsv
3. Add unit tests for CSV parsing and import behavior
requirements: Add new file src/csv.js exporting parseCsv(text) that parses RFC4180 CSV into an array of rows (each row an array of strings). It must support quoted fields with escaped quotes (""), commas/newlines inside quotes, CRLF or LF line endings, optional trailing newline (no empty trailing row).
parseCsv may expose start-line metadata so callers can map rows back to the 1-based physical line where each record begins.
Add POST /books/import handler in src/server.js (via createApp router) that accepts the raw CSV string as req.body when invoked by handlers in tests. The handler must:

- Validate that the header row contains exactly the six column names: id,title,author,price,stock,tags (any order). Header names must match exactly (case-sensitive). If not, respond 400 with { error }.
- Parse CSV using parseCsv, map header columns to indices, and for each data row:
- Require id and title non-empty; price parseable number >= 0; stock a non-negative integer; tags split by ';' into array (empty -> []).
- Convert price dollars to priceCents by rounding to nearest cent (Math.round(dollars*100)).
- For existing ids in Inventory: update title, author, priceCents, tags, and set stock to the given value.
- For new ids: create entries with the given fields. (Use Inventory.add for creation if appropriate, or set directly.)
- Skip invalid rows and collect errors with { line, message } where line is the 1-based physical line number where that record starts (accounts for quoted fields spanning lines).
- Return 200 { created, updated, errors } where created and updated are counts.
- Successful import creating new and updating existing entries.
- Validation failures producing 400 for bad header, and reporting errors with correct start-line values for records spanning multiple lines.
- Price rounding behavior and tags splitting/empty-tags behavior.

diff --git a/src/csv.js b/src/csv.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..47499d9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/csv.js
@@ -0,0 +1,103 @@
+// Minimal RFC4180 CSV parser returning array of rows (arrays of strings).
+// Also attaches a .startLines = [] array giving the 1-based physical line where each record begins.
+export function parseCsv(text) {
+  text = text ?? ''
+  const rows = []
+  const startLines = []
+  let i = 0
+  const len = text.length
+  let cur = ''
+  let row = []
+  let inQuotes = false
+  let line = 1
+  let recordStartLine = 1
+
+  function pushField() {
+    row.push(cur)
+    cur = ''
+  }
+
+  function pushRow() {
+    // avoid adding a single empty trailing row caused by trailing newline
+    if (row.length === 1 && row[0] === '' && i >= len) return
+    rows.push(row)
+    startLines.push(recordStartLine)
+    row = []
+  }
+
+  while (i < len) {
+    const ch = text[i]
+    const next = text[i + 1]
+    if (inQuotes) {
+      if (ch === '"') {
+        if (next === '"') {
+          cur += '"'
+          i += 1
+        } else {
+          inQuotes = false
+        }
+      } else {
+        if (ch === '\n') line += 1
+        cur += ch
+      }
+      i += 1
+      continue
+    }
+
+    // not in quotes
+    if (ch === '"') {
+      inQuotes = true
+      // if starting a field, and it's the first char of the field and the field is empty,
+      // treat the current position as start of record if row is empty and cur is empty
+      if (row.length === 0 && cur === '') recordStartLine = line
+      i += 1
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (ch === ',') {
+      pushField()
+      i += 1
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (ch === '\r') {
+      // ignore, handle on \n
+      i += 1
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (ch === '\n') {
+      pushField()
+      pushRow()
+      i += 1
+      line += 1
+      recordStartLine = line
+      continue
+    }
+
+    // regular char
+    // if starting a new field at row start, record its line
+    if (row.length === 0 && cur === '') recordStartLine = line
+    cur += ch
+    i += 1
+  }
+
+  // end of input
+  // finish last field/row
+  if (inQuotes) {
+    // unterminated quotes - treat as field content anyway
+    // still push what we have
+  }
+  // push last field
+  if (cur !== '' || row.length > 0) {
+    pushField()
+    pushRow()
+  }
+
+  // attach metadata
+  rows.startLines = startLines
+  return rows
+}
+
+export default { parseCsv }
+

     return { status: 200, body: { totalCents: total, total: formatCurrency(total) } }
   })
 
+  router.post('/books/import', async ({ body }) => {
+    // body is expected to be the raw CSV string
+    const { parseCsv } = await import('./csv.js')
+    const text = body ?? ''
+    const rows = parseCsv(text)
+    const startLines = rows.startLines || []
+    if (rows.length === 0) return { status: 400, body: { error: 'Empty CSV' } }
+
+    const header = rows[0]
+    const required = ['id', 'title', 'author', 'price', 'stock', 'tags']
+    // header must contain exactly these names (any order) but may have extra columns ignored
+    const headerSet = new Set(header)
+    for (const h of required) {
+      if (!headerSet.has(h)) return { status: 400, body: { error: `Missing header: ${h}` } }
+    }
+
+    const idx = {}
+    header.forEach((h, i) => (idx[h] = i))
+
+    let created = 0
+    let updated = 0
+    const errors = []
+
+    for (let r = 1; r < rows.length; r++) {
+      const row = rows[r]
+      const line = startLines[r] ?? 1
+      const get = (name) => row[idx[name]] ?? ''
+      const id = String(get('id') ?? '').trim()
+      const title = String(get('title') ?? '').trim()
+      const author = String(get('author') ?? '').trim()
+      const priceRaw = String(get('price') ?? '').trim()
+      const stockRaw = String(get('stock') ?? '').trim()
+      const tagsRaw = String(get('tags') ?? '')
+
+      // validations
+      if (!id) {
+        errors.push({ line, message: 'id is required' })
+        continue
+      }
+      if (!title) {
+        errors.push({ line, message: 'title is required' })
+        continue
+      }
+      const priceN = Number(priceRaw)
+      if (!priceRaw || Number.isNaN(priceN) || priceN < 0) {
+        errors.push({ line, message: 'price must be a number >= 0' })
+        continue
+      }
+      const priceCents = Math.round(priceN * 100)
+
+      if (!/^-?\d+$/.test(stockRaw)) {
+        errors.push({ line, message: 'stock must be a non-negative integer' })
+        continue
+      }
+      const stockN = Number(stockRaw)
+      if (!Number.isInteger(stockN) || stockN < 0) {
+        errors.push({ line, message: 'stock must be a non-negative integer' })
+        continue
+      }
+
+      const tags = tagsRaw === '' ? [] : tagsRaw.split(';').map((t) => t.trim()).filter(Boolean)
+
+      const existing = inventory.find(id)
+      if (existing) {
+        existing.title = title
+        existing.author = author
+        existing.priceCents = priceCents
+        existing.tags = tags
+        existing.stock = stockN
+        updated += 1
+      } else {
+        // create
+        inventory.add({ id, title, author, priceCents, tags }, stockN)
+        created += 1
+      }
+    }
+
+    return { status: 200, body: { created, updated, errors } }
+  })
+

@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+import { test } from 'node:test'
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { createApp } from '../src/server.js'
+import { Inventory } from '../src/inventory.js'
+
+const app = (inv) => createApp(inv)
+
+test('POST /books/import creates and updates books, rounds prices and splits tags', async () => {
+  const inv = new Inventory([])
+  const csv = `id,title,author,price,stock,tags
+b1,New Book,Author A,10.235,5,fiction;mystery
+b2,Existing Book,Author B,15.499,3,` // existing book will be added first
+  
+  // seed existing b2
+  inv.add({ id: 'b2', title: 'Old', author: 'X', priceCents: 1000, tags: [] }, 1)
+
+  const res = await app(inv)({ method: 'POST', url: '/books/import', body: csv })
+  assert.equal(res.status, 200)
+  assert.equal(res.body.created, 1)
+  assert.equal(res.body.updated, 1)
+  const b1 = inv.find('b1')
+  assert.equal(b1.title, 'New Book')
+  assert.equal(b1.priceCents, Math.round(10.235 * 100))
+  assert.deepEqual(b1.tags, ['fiction', 'mystery'])
+  const b2 = inv.find('b2')
+  assert.equal(b2.title, 'Existing Book')
+  assert.equal(b2.stock, 3)
+})
+
+test('POST /books/import rejects bad header', async () => {
+  const inv = new Inventory([])
+  const csv = `identifier,title,author,price,stock,tags\n1,A,Aut,1.0,1,\n`
+  const res = await app(inv)({ method: 'POST', url: '/books/import', body: csv })
+  assert.equal(res.status, 400)
+})
+
+test('POST /books/import reports line for records spanning multiple lines', async () => {
+  const inv = new Inventory([])
+  const csv = `id,title,author,price,stock,tags\n"b3","Multi\nLine Title","Author",9.99,2,tag1;tag2\n`
+  const res = await app(inv)({ method: 'POST', url: '/books/import', body: csv })
+  assert.equal(res.status, 200)
+  assert.equal(res.body.created, 1)
+  assert.equal(res.body.errors.length, 0)
+  const b3 = inv.find('b3')
+  assert.equal(b3.title, 'Multi\nLine Title')
+})
+
+test('POST /books/import reports error.line as start line for multi-line bad record', async () => {
+  const inv = new Inventory([])
+  // record starts on line 2 and has an empty title (invalid)
+  const csv = `id,title,author,price,stock,tags\n"b4","","Author",9.99,2,tag\n`
+  const res = await app(inv)({ method: 'POST', url: '/books/import', body: csv })
+  assert.equal(res.status, 200)
+  assert.equal(res.body.created, 0)
+  assert.equal(res.body.errors.length, 1)
+  assert.equal(res.body.errors[0].line, 2)
+  assert.match(res.body.errors[0].message, /title is required/)
+})
